name: 2spk_long
description: Longer two-speaker catch-up; exercises WER + diarization stability over many turns.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's so good to finally catch up. How have you been?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Pretty good, honestly. Work has been busy, but the good kind of busy. How about you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Same here. I actually started taking a pottery class on the weekends.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Pottery? That's great. I never would have pictured you at a wheel covered in clay.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I know. It's messier than I expected, but it's weirdly relaxing. You should come try a session sometime.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I might take you up on that. I've been looking for something to do that isn't staring at a screen.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's exactly why I started. My eyes were begging me for a break.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Tell me about it. So, are you still planning that trip out to the coast this summer?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, we booked it last week. Two weeks near the water, no laptop allowed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That sounds perfect. Send me pictures, especially of the sunsets.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Absolutely. And you have to promise you'll actually take some time off too.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Deal. Let's grab coffee before you leave and plan it all out.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'd love that. Same place as always?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Where else? I'll see you Saturday.
